description: Header file defining interfaces for board-related functions in the rt-loader component, including memory retrieval, system info, panic handling, and character output.

methods.name: board_get_memory
methods.description: Returns the amount of memory available on the board.

methods.name: board_get_system
methods.description: Fills the provided buffer with system information, up to the specified length.

methods.name: board_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to the board's output device.
